function.arguments: {"answer": "The email campaign did not improve conversion compared to paid search; in fact, it had a lower conversion rate in every customer segment, and the stratified difference in conversion rates (email minus paid_search) is -0.125.", "value": -0.125, "method": "Because the email campaign was deliberately targeted at high-value customers (loyal and returning), the raw difference in conversion rates between channels was confounded by customer segment.
